newsitem.title: USA: Aceto Corp sees FY97 net off - Barron's.
newsitem.headline: Aceto Corp sees FY97 net off - Barron's.

text.p: Officers of chemicals marketer Aceto Corp said the company's sales and earnings for the fiscal year ending in June will be off about 10 percent, excluding extraordinary charges, Barron's said Sunday.
The financial weekly said this means the company should report $1.20 a share for the year, compared to $1.34 in 1996.

Don Horowitz, chief financial officer of the Lake Success, N.Y.-based company, told Barron's that Aceto's earnings were lower in the third quarter ended in March, but should turn positive in the June quarter.
Horowitz and company President Leonard Schwartz also said fiscal 1998 should show an improvement over fiscal 1997, Barron's said.
Aceto shares closed Friday unchanged at 12-3/4.
